summary: 新能源车保险费用、维修成本和残值会影响消费者总拥有成本，尤其高维修成本或低残值阶段可能削弱单纯由电池降本带来的购车优势。
why_search_may_miss_it: 锂电需求模型通常只考虑车价/油电价，不包含保险和残值。

recalled_details.gap_reason: auto-macro pass covered tax/finance/fuel but not insurance/repair/residual-value economics

suggested_queries: 新能源车 保险 残值 维修 成本 2022 2023
EV insurance residual value repair cost China
disconfirmation_queries: EV purchase decisions independent of insurance and residual value

summary: 新能源车置换/报废更新政策会让销量中一部分来自存量换新而非新增保有量，长期电池需求应区分新增车队和替换需求。
why_search_may_miss_it: 销量统计不区分首次购车和存量替换。

recalled_details.gap_reason: replacement-demand logic was identified for non-EV applications but not vehicle fleet turnover
recalled_details.schema_implication: vehicle demand should distinguish fleet_addition vs replacement sales

suggested_queries: 新能源汽车 以旧换新 置换 销量 2024
disconfirmation_queries: all NEV sales add one-for-one to vehicle fleet

summary: 低线城市/县乡市场的新能源渗透曾被多次视为下一阶段增长来源，但充电条件、车型价格和使用场景与一二线城市不同，渗透路径不宜统一外推。
why_search_may_miss_it: 全国渗透率会掩盖区域差异，‘下乡’活动和地方数据分散。

recalled_details.gap_reason: charging infrastructure was covered nationally but regional diffusion expectations remained thin

suggested_queries: 新能源汽车 下乡 县域 渗透率 2022 2023
China EV rural county penetration forecast
disconfirmation_queries: EV penetration path identical across city tiers

summary: 电池租赁、车电分离和BaaS类商业模式会改变车辆售价与电池资产归属，使‘卖出一辆车=终端用户购买一个电池包’的会计和需求含义发生变化。
why_search_may_miss_it: 销量和电池装车数据看不出电池资产由谁持有和如何折旧。

recalled_details.gap_reason: swap network expectations were covered, but battery asset ownership/accounting was not

suggested_queries: BaaS 车电分离 电池资产 公司 模式
battery as a service ownership accounting China EV
disconfirmation_queries: battery leasing has no effect on vehicle/battery asset economics
disconfirmation_source_types: 电池资产/租赁收入披露

summary: 电池寿命和衰减改善会延长车辆/电池实际使用年限，既降低早期换电池需求，也推迟回收原料出现时间；早期固定寿命假设可能低估这种变化。
why_search_may_miss_it: 需求和回收模型常使用固定8年/固定循环寿命，不保留产品代际改善。

recalled_details.gap_reason: retirement forecasts were covered in recycling, but vehicle-side lifetime improvement as cause was not explicit

suggested_queries: 动力电池 寿命 衰减 质保 代际 改善
EV battery degradation lifetime improvement warranty China

summary: 车型改款/降价前后的老款清库存会短期扭曲订单、交付和电池采购，车端库存不只是经销商总量，还可能体现具体车型代际库存。
why_search_may_miss_it: 月度品牌销量无法看到车型代际库存，价格战时期改款频繁。

recalled_details.gap_reason: channel inventory was covered at aggregate level, not model-generation level

suggested_queries: 新能源车 改款 清库存 老款 降价 2023
EV model refresh inventory clearance China
disconfirmation_queries: vehicle model refresh has no short-term battery procurement/inventory effect
